title: Esoteric
description: Animations, Visual Effects, Terrian Enhancements + Structures. This pack also includes rebalancing of bosses. which makes some mobs + bosses more difficult
body:
Welcome To Esoteric! 
Made by Fierce, Nonecadaverva

This pack is all about inproving the game without adding too many features. the pack includes
Animation And Particle Mods and Visual Upgrades. Terrain, Mob tweaks & More Blocks!
We decided to leave out farmers delight and create mod due to feature creep and wanting a specific vanilla + fantacy vibe. 



__________________________________________________________________________________________
Don't worry if you don't like shaders because the base games visuals have been improved as well!

This Pack is Sort of difficult to run with shaders on. 

Recommended Specs For (Proton Shader and modpack)
[Resolution 1440p]
RTX 3060 or Amd Equivelant (6GB VRAM+)
Ryzen 5 5600x or Intel Equivelant
16GB RAM
SSD


Minimum Specs For (12 Chunks No Shaders)
[Resolution 1080p]
 
RTX 1060 or AMD Equivelant [4GB VRAM]
Ryzen 5 2400g or Intel Equivelant
12GB RAM
SSD

Pack is subject to change, welcome to give feedback on patreon or youtube comments!
